description:
North star: compile work proportional to input. A product whose value depends on facts only is computed once per compile and shared by every root and job; it never borrows a root.

Fact (reader xxd14/reader.md on e4c33bceb): every product lives in one root's PullSession (ProductSessions.sessions: HashMap<RootId, PullSession>, pull.rs:1572); invalidation (reconcile_fact_movements, mutate_product_wave) and recursive groups (PendingStrongComponent::find, pull.rs:474) are per session. Spike B had to borrow a root for ProductKey::Reach and both choices broke (first root: "no ready producer" on every program; last root: macro roots minted mid-compile by World::macro_root make 00593 miscompile). StructSchema(ModuleId) has the same latent problem: no root in its key, but each root's session computes its own copy (jobs/backend.rs:170, 317).

Design (proposal ../fz-xxd.14.html, approved 2026-10-12):
- ProductScope = Root(RootId) | Program, chosen by the key: ProductKey::scope(asking_root). StructSchema (and Reach, in fz-xxd.13) -> Program; every other key -> Root(asking).
- ProductAddress { scope, key }, built only by ProductAddress::of(key, asking_root); the literals at pull.rs:1680, 1886, 1911 and quoted_expander.rs:450 go.
- ProductSessions holds the root sessions plus one program session (same PullSession/ProductMemo machinery); fact routing maps become scope maps; a program-session product change emits DependencyKey::Product for its address, so readers in root sessions and jobs wake through the existing bridge (pull.rs:1657-1701); a rooted product may depend on a program product.
- Driving a waited product activates its address's scope; the program session's fact waits demand producers as root sessions do.
- Not chosen: recursive-group settlement in the fact layer (a second mechanism beside the product layer's).
- Open, not folded: transport products have root-free keys but read root-scoped executable facts; whether they could be program-scoped needs its own paper.

Acceptance:
- a program with two roots sharing a struct module evaluates StructSchema once (test, observed through product telemetry);
- census outputs identical against fz-xxd.10; jobs equal or lower; no pin rises;
- probe (not landed): spike B's Reach ported onto the program scope passes fixtures/00593 (run, interp, build) and recursive_callable_input_sources_settle_in_either_root_order, and 00607-00610 measure 16/4, 16/4, 18/4, 18/4;
- timing within noise of fz-xxd.10.
title: A product derived from facts alone needs no root
